comment.zh-TW: 海口未來 5 天的停飛風險主因是大雨／雷雨，集中在 10/29 白天。機場預報（TAF）在 10/29 08–14 時與 14–20 時都報有強雷雨，陣風 25 節、側風 4.3 節，規則燈依官方判為中。機場觀測（METAR）10/29 09 時已有弱雷雨，能見度 8000 公尺、雲底 4600 呎。模式層這兩格都是低，各模式 6 小時雨量最多 13.8 毫米，24 小時雨量超過 50 毫米的機率 0%。10/29 20 時以後官方與模式都判為低。

comment.en: The main driver of Haikou's disruption risk over the next 5 days is heavy rain/thunderstorms, concentrated in the daytime of 10/29. The airport forecast (TAF) calls for heavy thunderstorms on 10/29 08:00–14:00 and 14:00–20:00, with gusts of 25 kt and crosswind of 4.3 kt, and the rule light rates these Medium based on the official forecast. The airport observation (METAR) at 09:00 on 10/29 already reports light thunderstorms, visibility 8000 m and cloud base 4600 ft. The model layer rates both periods Low, with at most 13.8 mm of rain in 6 hours across the models and a 0% chance of more than 50 mm of rain in 24 hours. From 20:00 on 10/29 onward, both the official forecast and the models rate the risk Low.
